'''Daniel Heefner My kind of Scum''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Daniel Heefner]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-11444">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11444 My kind of Scum], DeckTech (Daniel "Darth Dan" Heefner, 30 October 2000). == Original post ==

'''My kind of Scum'''
* '''Author:''' Daniel "Darth Dan" Heefner
* '''Published:''' October 30, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' My kind of Scum that is waiting to be played.

=== Strategy ===

This Deck is pretty basic. Cancel Drains battle the retrieve. it gets nice retrieval. And battles well.Every Card in this deck has a pupose and if something is unclear send me a message before reviewing.

Darth Dan
